articles.title: Pulte appointment as spy chief would give a Trump attack dog access to an ocean of intelligence
articles.description: In his role atop the housing finance agency, Bill Pulte has used his access to mortgage records to refer some top Trump opponents for prosecution.

articles.title: Cassidy: Pulte not 'competent' for intelligence director role
articles.description: Intelligence community veterans have warned that Pulte is ill-prepared for the job and could target Trump's foes in the role.

articles.title: Trump names housing official Bill Pulte as acting US spymaster
articles.description: The head of the Federal Housing Finance Agency, who pushed for criminal charges against Trump's foes, will step in as acting Director of National Intelligence.
